stem: President Franklin D. Roosevelt sought to reassure the American public during uncertain economic times by —

options.label: F
options.text: publishing a weekly news editorial titled “The Road to Prosperity and Peace”

options.label: G
options.text: holding weekly town-hall meetings with average citizens

options.label: H
options.text: making short appearances in a variety of Hollywood films

options.label: J
options.text: delivering a series of evening radio speeches known as fireside chats
